Week 3: Persuasive Language

Learning intention: we are learning to identify persuasive techniques in advertisements.

Success criteria

  • I can name three persuasive techniques.
  • I can explain how one technique tries to change the reader's mind.

Key words

WordMeaning
Emotive languageWords chosen to make the reader feel something
Rhetorical questionA question asked for effect, not for an answer

Read the advertisement, then answer the questions. Due Friday.
